description: Ross Stores, Inc. and its subsidiaries operate two brands of off-price retail apparel and home fashion stores, Ross Dress for Less and dds DISCOUNTS. Ross is the largest off-price apparel and home fashion chain in the United States, with 1,904 locations in 44 states, the District of Columbia, Guam and Puerto Rico as of January 31, 2026, and Ross offers first-quality, in-season, brand name and designer apparel, accessories, footwear and home fashions for the entire family at savings of 20 to 60 percent off department and specialty store regular prices every day, with its target customers primarily from middle income households. It also operates 363 dds DISCOUNTS stores in 22 states as of January 31, 2026, and dds DISCOUNTS features more moderately-priced first-quality, in-season apparel, accessories, footwear and home fashions for the entire family at savings of 20 to 70 percent off moderate department and discount store regular prices every day.
